test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

Sahukaars provide loan__ in 2% interest rate for a month__, which is higher than the bank charges.
solution:
The correct answer is **At 2% interest rate per month.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence can be improved by replacing the **"In** 2% interest rate per month.**" **with** "**At 2% interest rate per month**."**
 
• We use the preposition **"in"** when describing a location in relation to a bigger area.
 
 
• **Example: ***The novel is in my locker.*
 
 
 
• We use the preposition **"at"** when we talk about prices and numbers.
 
 
• **Example:** *We booked the hotel at 2500 rupees.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct option is At 2% interest rate per month**.**

The correct sentence is: **Sahukaars provide loan at 2% interest rate per month which is higher than the bank charges**
